items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: We went often to the Metropole bar where Red Allen was leading a band which had ... Lemont "Benny" Moten playing bass.

ctx.x: Lily and I had made plans to go to the States for two months from April until June. She had never been there and I wanted her to meet my parents. After I closed at the Singerhaus, she and I stayed in Switzerland visiting friends and taking life easy until the 15th of March. We then came to Paris and I did a few gigs until our departure from Le Havre the 1st of April.

We sailed on the Liberte which was a fine ship and we enjoyed every mile from Le Havre to New York. I played a few numbers at the gala nights in each class which takes place on different nights. I had been in contact with Oran "Hot Lips" Page who had engaged a hotel in New York for us. He along with some other friends were at the pier to meet us when we docked at the pier at 6.a.m. the 7th of April. We stayed in the Apple until the 15th and I saw many of my friends, my best pals al Hall and Dickie Wells, and many…

Charlie Shavers was leading the other group at the Metropole and the joint was jumping every night. Red featured a song called "Kiss the Baby" and any fellow that was with a woman, Red would ask if she was the baby. If the fellow said yes, then Red would tell him to kiss the baby and he would insist until the fellow kissed the woman. He had me kissing Lily in public at least twice every time we went to the place. Another thing he would do was when a musician came into the bar, that he knew, and he knew many, Red…
